title: Nik's Craftables - Plants
description: Adds recipes to craft plants. Useful for builders or plant lovers!
body:
![purple text in the style of minecraft's logo that reads "CRAFTABLES"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eccdd03eda4eebaaf673eae9f78a289d03cc3314.png)

Adds more recipes for plants! Plants can add a lot to builds, but sometimes they require a lot to collect!

Recipes that are not in the crafting table guide:
- Furnance
  - Short Grass -> Short Dry Grass
  - Tall Grass -> Tall Dry Grass
  - Bush -> Dead Bush
- Campfire
  - Horn Coral Block -> Sponge
